phase_1_parser_adapter_boundary.title: Phase 1 — parser adapter boundary
phase_1_parser_adapter_boundary.summary: Add src/lib/documentParsing/ and move the current Quick Check extractor behind an adapter boundary. Keep retrieval/evaluation behavior intact and do not start LiteParse yet.

phase_2_article6_document_model.title: Phase 2 — canonical Article6 document model
phase_2_article6_document_model.summary: Add src/lib/documentModel/ as the canonical document representation for normalized sections, hierarchy, provenance, and cleaned display text.

phase_3_retrieval_evaluation_split.title: Phase 3 — section retrieval and evidence evaluation split
phase_3_retrieval_evaluation_split.summary: Separate candidate section retrieval from evidence sufficiency judgment so routing and verdict semantics can evolve independently.

phase_4_declarative_review_policy.title: Phase 4 — declarative typed review policy
phase_4_declarative_review_policy.summary: Move aliases, preferred sections, negative sections, fallback rules, boosts, penalties, and evidence signals into typed JSON validated by Zod.

phase_5_eval_harness.title: Phase 5 — Quick Check eval harness
phase_5_eval_harness.summary: Add fixture-backed retrieval and verdict evals so pipeline changes are measured and gated before merge.

phase_6_secondary_parser_adapter.title: Phase 6 — secondary parser adapter
phase_6_secondary_parser_adapter.summary: Add LiteParse as a second parser adapter only after the adapter boundary and canonical document model are stable.

phase_meta.summary: Move Quick Check from tactical section-matching patches to a layered document pipeline with explicit parser, document-model, retrieval, evaluation, UI, and eval boundaries.
phase_meta.current_focus: Phase 5 only: plan and implement a fixture-backed Quick Check eval harness for retrieval and verdict regression testing before more parser work. Phase 4 declarative review policy is complete, and LiteParse remains out of scope until the eval harness exists.
not_active_now: Additional Quick Check tactical alias patches
